title: Concept: Redirect via http.Redirect (go) — review required
description: In go, http.Redirect issues a redirect to a caller-chosen address. Open targets let attackers craft trusted-looking links to hostile sites. The remedy is target validation via a same-origin check.
applicability: go request handlers redirecting through http.Redirect; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Phishing and token theft via trusted-domain links; MEDIUM severity, HIGH when redirects carry tokens.
